title: Smart Touchscreen Display
description: 10.1-inch tiltable capacitive touchscreen with an intuitive smartphone-style user interface, easy navigation, and customizable quick-access shortcuts.

title: Duplexing Document Feeder
description: High-capacity single-pass duplexing document feeder (DSPF) capable of rapid two-sided scanning with multi-feed detection.

title: Internal Output Tray
description: Central output paper delivery area with integrated paper sensor, sorting capability, and LED notification indicators.

title: Front Toner Access Panel
description: Ergonomic front-opening compartment for fast, mess-free toner cartridge replacement with automatic cartridge locking.

title: Universal Paper Cassettes
description: High-capacity dual paper cassettes supporting a wide range of media weights and custom document formats.
